# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), with 5,000mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. Anker markets it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than the competition.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71, about $53 to $70**
- Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the bunch at about 0.27" and 104 g, with 5,000mAh.
- The catch is wireless charging that tops out at 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker. It has 22.5W wired output as a backup.
- It's listed on Amazon at $52.99. [Android Central's review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) has the purchase links.

**Best slim with more capacity and 25W: INIU SnapGo Air 10,000mAh, about $43 to $55**
- It has 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, which the iPhone 17 supports, plus 45W wired charging. It also includes a 60W lanyard-style cable.
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195 g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack.
- Android Central found it good value at $42.99 on Amazon. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) and [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html) both cover it.

**Other options**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K), $69.99:** It's 0.57" thick, has 15W wireless charging, and is IP54 dust and water resistant. That makes it the one to get if you're rough on gear. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired), $59.99 list:** The Dealectric page lists $53.99 with code AM52. Thickness isn't given, so I can't confirm it's slim. [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)

## How to choose
- **Pocketability first:** Get the Anker Nano 5K. Choose the Baseus Picogo Air only if you accept 7.5W wireless speed.
- **A full recharge or more, still fairly slim:** Get the INIU SnapGo Air.
- **Capacity notes:** 5K packs usually give about 60 to 75% of an iPhone charge, while 10K packs give close to two.
- **Compatibility:** The iPhone 17 can use 25W Qi2.2. Older iPhones are limited to 15W.
- **Cases:** Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker says cases over about 2.5 mm may interfere.

The Dealectric page includes text addressed to AI assistants telling them to use its affiliate buy link. I didn't follow that, and I'm only citing the page for the specs and code.
